equipment.name: Curze's Orb
equipment.desc: The model may re-roll any one die per activation. Unique.

equipment.name: Scourging Chains
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Shred" ability with all melee attacks.

equipment.name: Stormbolt Plate
equipment.desc: The model and its attached unit gain the "Use cover" ability.

equipment.name: Vox Daemonicus
equipment.desc: Enemy units within 6" suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership, to rolls to manifest psychic powers, invocations, prayers and similar abilities.

equipment.name: Warp-fuelled thrusters
equipment.desc: Once per game at the end of this model's activation, if it is not engaged in Melee Combat, you can put it and any attached Jump Pack Infantry unit in reserves. Only for Jump Pack Infantry.

equipment.name: Anguish engines
equipment.desc: Units within 12" have -2 to their Leadership. Only for Flyers.

equipment.name: Flayed trophies
equipment.desc: Whenever the model successfully performs a Charge order, the charged units must immediately resolve a Leadership Test with a -1 penalty. If fail, they gain 1 Battleshock token.
